value.signature: fn resolve_recipients (history : & ValidatedHistory , boundary : u64 , verifier : & impl RegistrationVerifier , limits : Limits ,) -> Result < Vec < ResolvedCell > , RecipientError >

review.body: { let cells = fold_cells (history , boundary , verifier , limits . clone ()) ? ; let graph = pn_graph :: formation :: reconstruct_replay (history , verifier) . map_err (CellError :: from) ? ; let title = pn_graph :: title :: replay_title (& graph , history , verifier , boundary) ? ; let anchors : BTreeSet < _ > = history . acts () . iter () . filter (| act | act . position () . 0 <= boundary && act . id () . family == "Registration") . map (| act | act . id () . author . as_str ()) . collect () ; let mut budget = Budget :: new (limits) ? ; let mut output = Vec :: new () ; for cell in cells { let mut positive = true ; for spelling in cell . coordinates . values () { let coordinate = Rational :: parse (spelling , & mut budget) ? ; positive &= ! coordinate . is_negative () && ! coordinate . is_zero () ; } let target = if positive { match cell . identity . family . as_str () { "Opinion" => profile (& cell , Role :: Binary) , "Reference" | "Invitation" => profile (& cell , Role :: T) , "Accept" | "Ratify" => title . events . iter () . find_map (| event | { if event . outcome != TitleOutcome :: Transferred { return None ; } if cell . identity . family == "Accept" && cell . members . contains (& event . acts [1]) { Some (event . buyer . as_str ()) } else if cell . identity . family == "Ratify" && cell . members . contains (& event . acts [2]) { Some (event . seller . as_str ()) } else { None } }) , _ => None , } } else { None } ; let recipient = target . filter (| target | anchors . contains (target)) . unwrap_or (& cell . identity . author) . to_owned () ; output . push (ResolvedCell { cell , recipient }) ; } Ok (output) }
review.item_premise: Recipient resolution consumes public validated history, the boundary, a declared public verifier and exact-arithmetic limits. It derives cells, Registration anchors and persistent title events, retaining all member identities. Positive Opinion, Reference and Invitation Profile targets resolve to anchored persons; other recipients follow the family and title-event rules, with nonpositive or unanchored targets home. Invitation netting may withdraw or restore its vouch, while De-invite remains home. Public arguments, results and refusals remain fully observable; no private opening or observation output affects routing.
